findings.text: the reviewed head 52873a29680b62844102f288cd46d297643ebbd3 is not cited anywhere in the manifest: commits (line 11), changed_paths (line 12) and checkpoint (line 10) all stop at 3f576e4b76, so the run's own report describes the tree before the commit whose fragment content this review read, and a reader who lands the run at the checkpoint it names lands a tree that is not the head

the fragment states '300 decodes for 300 pointers' as a measured figure (repeated at lines 61-63), but no log in the run directory prints a decode count; the head assertion is the bound tests/test_fleet_state_reads_the_live_pointers_once.py:253 decodes.count <= POINTERS, so the number is implied by a passing run rather than read from one

the negative-control row (lines 88-92) and the control paragraph (lines 106-119) cite 442cb3178b plus the one-line revert, but the test they describe was rewritten at 3f576e4b76 (fixture shape at tests/test_fleet_state_reads_the_live_pointers_once.py:160-175 and the projection at :325-327) and _pointer_as_read gained hydration, so no recorded arm shows the reworded assertion reddening on the reverted deep copy it claims to guard

the decode counter only counts documents carrying run_id, so the 300-document figure it bounds excludes the node.json body each pointer now names (reckon/crew/runs.py:283-291 is read once per by-id read, without a memo), and a regression that re-read the body per pointer would not redden the assertion at :253
